matrix.requirement: One origin admission, nested modules, SQLite/schema/path
matrix.tests: origin admission 0/1/5; unknown unloaded module; real actual-file and schema tests
matrix.counters: Actual filesystem readdir/opendir, lstat/stat/realpath/readlink, readFile; open recorded separately to avoid double-counting readFile internal open

matrix.requirement: Independent operation and mutation freshness after await
matrix.tests: same-stack/await/serialized origin; bytes preserved size+mtime, mode, add/delete, file/directory, aliases, registry/inventory/module/proof/state-path mutations
matrix.invariant: Refuse before opening/modifying database, WAL or SHM

matrix.requirement: Parallel, retained generations, serialized/forged proof, refusal/retry
matrix.tests: parallel independent A/B, retained A after active B, invalid proof and subsequent valid retry
matrix.invariant: Operation permission cannot transfer; each independent admission has its own complete inventory

matrix.requirement: Whole agent ps shared observation snapshot
matrix.invariant: One store/context/close, EMA/profile, identity state/time/reason, claims and pending event uniqueness; zero empty or at most one nonempty global scan

matrix.requirement: Fresh full identities and unknown preservation
matrix.tests: start/command/missing/denied/malformed/disappeared/machine/boot/host-machine/host-boot; same PID different full identities; mixed PID evidence; pane id/PID/command/denied
matrix.invariant: No invented alive; fresh observations after await and before ownership delivery

matrix.requirement: Known Linux wait N iterations and complete command counters
matrix.tests: observation-only N=1/3/7; whole entry agent run legacy/queue N=1/4 with seven readiness/delivery outcomes
matrix.counters: All executor commands and targeted /proc content reads retained across per-pass resets; total global scans=0; targeted costs scale with unique per-pass identities plus explicitly declared ownership/finalization boundaries

matrix.requirement: Origin and process boundaries during wait
matrix.tests: protected-state/launch/stop/delivery boundary cases; protected-state whole agent run
matrix.invariant: One new inventory traversal per declared origin boundary; old OS snapshot cannot authorize new action

matrix.requirement: Readiness, queue, ownership, brief delivery, errors, profile and help/parser
matrix.tests: real production entry/app-runtime/queue flow/TmuxAgentAdapter launch transport with controlled fixture ports; ready/protected-state/timeout/unknown/pane-lost/delivery-error/ownership-changed
matrix.invariant: Exactly-once literal brief, reserve/commit/abort/fence/claim handoff; primary errors; profile/EMA; zero runtime work for help/parser

limitations: This is unit test scaffolding: controlled OS executor and lifecycle ports exercise real origin/SQLite/entry/queue/transport code; live CPU/wall, real runner and full production delivery acceptance remain 5.11/main.
Historical attempts 1-4 were refusals; 5 setup syntax failure corrected before red; 6 transport output truncated and not final full evidence. Only final-red is the definitive full result.

Installed capture replay removes result files and lacks context/hash manifest fields. Read-only descriptors retained complete own streams before unlink; delivery attestation records verified byte lengths, hashes, context and independent CLI code. No capture was changed or hard-linked.
Runtime resourceUsage reports partial/unknown CPU-independent memory/disk attribution; no benchmark or full CPU claim is made.

validation.finalEvidenceIntegrity: SHA-256 and byte lengths verified; full stdout parses as exactly one JSON TestRunResult; code/selection/outcome/cleanup and all diagnostics verified
